timeline.title: The First Hello
timeline.description: Where it all began at the little cafe downtown. I remember the way you stirred your coffee while we talked for three hours straight. It felt like time stopped just for us.

timeline.title: Summer Sunset
timeline.description: Our first trip to the beach together. We sat on that old driftwood and watched the sky turn from orange to lavender. That was the moment I knew I never wanted to watch a sunset without you.

timeline.title: The First Apartment
timeline.description: Boxes everywhere, sleeping on a mattress on the floor, and eating pizza out of the box. Our first real home together wasn't perfect, but it was ours.

timeline.title: Winter Wonderland
timeline.description: The most magical holiday season. The city was glowing, and so were you. We promised to make every Christmas just as special as this one.

timeline.title: The Great Adventure
timeline.description: Hiking up the ridge at dawn. We were exhausted, breathless, but the view from the top—and the look in your eyes—made every step worth it.

endingMessage: To many more years of us.
